# Matthew Sullivan

> Full-stack software engineer in Arizona. He is a Full-Stack Developer at EHMA.ai, working on wAve, an AI-powered solar sales platform, and builds Sprout AAC, a free, open-source communication app for kids, in his own time.

This is a single-page portfolio. Everything below is on https://matthewsullivan.dev/.

## Work
- EHMA.ai: owns wAve across the full stack. In 11 weeks set up CI/CD and monitoring, raised test coverage by 828%, cut API response times from 18 s to 316 ms, migrated 556K records with no downtime, and overhauled personal-data handling.
- Tibit Communications (earlier): embedded and manufacturing software, including a device branding station and a network statistics web interface that ships in the Tibit/Ciena PON Manager product.

## Projects
- [Sprout AAC](https://sproutaac.org): free, open-source AAC app built in Flutter. v0.1.0 is out for macOS; iOS/Android builds and Open Board Format support are in progress.
- [ClearPath](https://clearpathext.com): open-source browser extension for read-aloud, reading mode, symbol overlays and text simplification (uses the reader's own LLM API key). Not yet in browser stores.
- [Redacted Records](https://theredactedrecords.com): booking and portfolio site built for a Phoenix mixing and mastering engineer.
- [Python: First Contact](https://python-first-contact.vercel.app): Python study quiz with an in-browser Python sandbox.

## Education
- B.S. Software Engineering, Arizona State University (Polytechnic campus)
